# unifi_network_settings (Resource)

Site-wide UniFi Network settings — a **singleton** whose sections are managed à la carte. Each section is an **optional nested block**; declare only the sections you want Terraform to manage. Omitting a block leaves that section unmanaged (Terraform never reads or writes it), and removing a previously-declared block stops managing that section without reverting it. Writes shallow-merge the configured fields over the controller's stored section, so unmodeled fields are preserved. **Writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `country` (Attributes) Site country (`country` section). Omit to leave the country unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--country))
- `locale` (Attributes) Site locale (`locale` section). Omit to leave the locale unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locale))
- `ntp` (Attributes) Time-synchronization settings (`ntp` section). Omit to leave NTP unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ntp))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of the site-settings singleton (`settings`).

<a id="nestedatt--country"></a>
### Nested Schema for `country`

Optional:

- `code` (Number) ISO-3166 **numeric** country code (e.g. `840` = US, `826` = GB, `276` = DE).


<a id="nestedatt--locale"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locale`

Optional:

- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone name (e.g. `America/New_York`, `Europe/London`).


<a id="nestedatt--ntp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ntp`

Optional:

- `ntp_server_1` (String) Custom NTP server 1 (applies when `setting_preference = manual`).
- `ntp_server_2` (String) Custom NTP server 2.
- `ntp_server_3` (String) Custom NTP server 3.
- `ntp_server_4` (String) Custom NTP server 4.
- `setting_preference` (String) `auto` (UniFi-provided servers) or `manual` (use the `ntp_server_*` fields).
